news.titleEn: Oil prices mixed as traders assess Middle East developments
news.conclusionEn: Brent held near $109 a barrel while WTI slipped to about $97, as Iran's Revolutionary Guards said mines disabled tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi Aramco sites.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹油轮遇袭，布伦特原油稳在约109美元
news.whyEn: Hormuz disruption keeps energy, shipping and inflation risks elevated for importers, airlines and central banks worldwide.
news.whyZh: 海峡航运受阻推高能源和运费，全球通胀与央行决策承压
news.detailEn: Brent rose 3 cents to settle at $108.82, while WTI fell 67 cents to $97.15. The IRGC said two tankers using routes Tehran deems unauthorized were set ablaze by mines, and Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Aramco facilities in Yanbu and the Shaybah field. Goldman Sachs estimates average crude freight rates have surged above $20 a barrel versus $3 a year ago, with war-risk premiums a big part of the jump. Any further escalation could push prices higher, while diplomatic progress remains the main downside risk for oil.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油上涨3美分收于108.82美元，WTI下跌67美分至97.15美元。伊朗革命卫队称，两艘走「未授权航线」的油轮触雷起火，也门胡塞武装则声称袭击了沙特阿美延布设施和谢巴油田。高盛估计，原油平均运费已从一年前的每桶3美元升至20美元以上，战争风险溢价占了很大一部分。局势若再升级，油价可能继续走高；外交进展则是油价下行的主要变量。

news.titleEn: Tesla beats on earnings and sales even as auto revenue declines
news.conclusionEn: Tesla's Q3 results topped estimates, but auto revenue fell 3%, net income dropped 29% and shares slid more than 3% after hours.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉三季度业绩超预期，但汽车收入下滑、股价盘后跌超3%
news.whyEn: It shows Tesla shifting spending to AI and robots while its core car business weakens, just as Musk floats a SpaceX merger.
news.whyZh: 核心汽车业务走弱、AI投入猛增，又叠加与SpaceX合并的讨论
news.detailEn: Automotive revenue declined 3% to $20.56 billion and energy revenue fell 16%, offset by a 33% jump in services. Net income fell 29% to $787 million as capital spending more than doubled to $3.73 billion on Optimus robots and AI. Active FSD subscriptions rose 67% to 1.74 million. The report came a day after Musk said both companies' boards formed special committees to discuss a possible Tesla–SpaceX tie-up.
news.detailZh: 汽车业务收入下降3%至205.6亿美元，能源收入下降16%，服务及其他收入增长33%部分抵消。由于Optimus机器人和AI投入，资本开支翻倍多至37.3亿美元，净利润下降29%至7.87亿美元。FSD活跃订阅数同比增长67%至174万。财报发布前一天，马斯克表示两家公司董事会已成立特别委员会讨论特斯拉与SpaceX可能的合并。

news.titleEn: French 10-year bond yield hits 5% for first time since 2002 amid unrest
news.conclusionEn: France's 10-year borrowing cost briefly topped 5% for the first time since 2002 as mass protests and a stalled budget rattled investors.
news.conclusionZh: 法国10年期国债收益率24年来首破5%
news.whyEn: Higher French borrowing costs strain public finances in the euro zone's second-largest economy and can spill over to other European bonds.
news.whyZh: 欧元区第二大经济体融资成本飙升，可能波及欧洲债市
news.detailEn: The OAT yield crossed 5% shortly before 11:30 a.m. Paris time before easing to around 4.98%. Violent protests and rioting over the weekend added to fears that a fractured parliament cannot pass the 2027 budget. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is targeting €54 billion in spending cuts, with the deficit at 5.1% of GDP against the EU's 3% goal. Retailer Carrefour's shares also plunged 14% after warning that the unrest would hit its business.
news.detailZh: 法国10年期国债收益率在巴黎时间上午11:30前突破5%，随后回落至约4.98%。周末的暴力抗议和骚乱，加剧了市场对分裂的议会无法通过2027年预算的担忧。总理勒科尔尼计划削减540亿欧元开支，而赤字占GDP比例为5.1%，远高于欧盟3%的目标。零售巨头家乐福也因警告骚乱将冲击业务，股价暴跌14%。

news.titleEn: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
news.conclusionEn: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in penalties in a data-privacy case stemming from the Cambridge Analytica scandal.
news.conclusionZh: Meta因数据隐私案被新墨西哥州罚款250亿美元
news.whyEn: It is one of the largest penalties ever against a tech firm and could embolden other US states to pursue similar consumer-protection cases.
news.whyZh: 科技公司史上最大罚单之一，或引发更多州效仿起诉
news.detailEn: A Santa Fe jury found in September that Meta misled residents about how it protects user data, finding more than 43 million violations of the state's Unfair Practices Act. The state had been awarded $219.5 billion before the judge reduced it to $25 billion at the maximum $5,000 per violation, with 15% annual interest until paid. Meta is expected to appeal. The ruling adds legal and financial pressure on big platforms over privacy and harmful content.
news.detailZh: 圣达菲陪审团9月裁定，Meta在保护用户数据方面误导了州民，违反《不公平行为法》超过4300万次。州政府原获判2195亿美元，法官按每次违规最高5000美元的标准减至250亿美元，未付清前按年息15%计息。预计Meta将上诉。此案加大了大型平台在隐私和有害内容方面的法律与财务压力。

news.titleEn: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
news.conclusionEn: Governments urged websites to patch two critical AI-discovered flaws in PHP, and some, including Finland's public services, went offline as a precaution.
news.conclusionZh: PHP曝两大严重漏洞，多国网站紧急下线
news.whyEn: PHP powers a large share of the internet, so businesses and governments everywhere face urgent patching and outage risks.
news.whyZh: PHP支撑大量网站，全球企业和政府都要紧急修补
news.detailEn: The vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language were fixed on Wednesday afternoon, but agencies told organizations that could not patch quickly to consider taking sites down. The Finnish government, Edinburgh council and the BBC were among those taking pages offline, and the Dutch cyber agency took its own site down. Security firm Wiz called them the most severe vulnerabilities ever discovered by AI. The episode highlights how AI is accelerating both the discovery and the exploitation risk of software flaws.
news.detailZh: PHP编程语言的漏洞已于周三下午发布修复，但多国机构建议无法及时修补的组织考虑先关停网站。芬兰政府、爱丁堡市议会和BBC等都下线了部分页面，荷兰网络安全机构也关闭了自家网站。安全公司Wiz称这是AI迄今发现的「最严重漏洞」。此事凸显AI正在同时加快漏洞的发现速度和被利用的风险。

news.titleEn: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
news.conclusionEn: Russian missiles struck Kyiv hours after Moscow said it was ready in principle to resume US-brokered peace talks.
news.conclusionZh: 俄同意恢复和谈数小时后，导弹再袭基辅
news.whyEn: Progress or failure in talks affects European security, energy markets and defense spending across the West.
news.whyZh: 和谈进展关乎欧洲安全、能源市场与西方军费
news.detailEn: Several houses were hit in Kyiv on Wednesday night, injuring six people, according to Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are leading a new diplomatic push, with Witkoff meeting Putin in St Petersburg a day after meeting Zelensky. Three-way talks had been paused since February, after which Russia intensified attacks. Trump said the sides were the closest they had been to ending the war, but analysts remain skeptical of an imminent deal.
news.detailZh: 据基辅市长克里琴科称，周三晚多座房屋被击中，6人受伤。美国特使威特科夫和库什纳正主导新一轮外交斡旋，威特科夫在会见泽连斯基一天后，在圣彼得堡会见了普京。三方谈判自2月起中断，此后俄罗斯加强了空袭。特朗普称目前是「离结束战争最近的时候」，但分析人士对短期达成协议仍持怀疑态度。

news.titleEn: Inflation and government borrowing highest for a year ahead of next week's Budget
news.conclusionEn: UK inflation rose to 3.5% in September and monthly borrowing hit nearly £25bn, both one-year highs, a week before the Budget.
news.conclusionZh: 英国通胀升至3.5%，借款创一年新高
news.whyEn: It narrows the chancellor's room in the Budget and makes Bank of England rate cuts less likely, affecting mortgages and the pound.
news.whyZh: 压缩预算空间，英国央行降息希望降低，影响房贷和英镑
news.detailEn: Consumer price inflation jumped from 3.1% in August to 3.5% in September, driven by sharp rises in petrol and diesel prices. Government borrowing reached almost £25bn in September, leaving the year-to-date total £6bn above official forecasts. Chancellor John Healey has pledged not to raise income tax, National Insurance or VAT while sticking to fiscal rules. Markets will watch next week's Budget for how he closes the gap.
news.detailZh: 受汽油和柴油价格大涨推动，英国CPI从8月的3.1%升至9月的3.5%。9月政府借款接近250亿英镑，本财年累计借款比官方预测高出60亿英镑。财政大臣希利承诺不提高所得税、国民保险和增值税，同时遵守财政规则。市场将关注下周预算如何弥补这一缺口。

news.titleEn: CoreWeave's market confidence erodes as bond yields spike and stock sinks
news.conclusionEn: Debt-heavy AI cloud provider CoreWeave is down 29% this month, with its unsecured bonds yielding about 15% as investors sour on neoclouds.
news.conclusionZh: AI算力商CoreWeave股债双杀，本月股价跌29%
news.whyEn: Stress in AI infrastructure credit signals that higher rates and build-out doubts could hit the most leveraged part of the AI boom.
news.whyZh: AI基建信用承压，高利率下高杠杆环节风险最大
news.detailEn: CoreWeave's market value has fallen to about $34 billion from a peak near $90 billion, and its five-year credit default swap spread is near 10.67%. Peers are also falling, with Nebius down 27% and IREN down 32% this month. Australia's NextDC plunged 40% after cutting its earnings forecast, and Firmus scrapped its IPO. Barclays noted how quickly sentiment on AI debt is shifting day to day.
news.detailZh: CoreWeave市值已从近900亿美元的高点跌至约340亿美元，五年期信用违约互换利差接近10.67%。同行同样下跌，Nebius本月跌27%，IREN跌32%。澳大利亚数据中心运营商NextDC下调盈利预期后暴跌40%，Firmus也取消了IPO。巴克莱指出，市场对AI相关债务的情绪正在一天一变。

news.titleEn: Southwest Airlines cuts 2026 profit forecast on higher fuel
news.conclusionEn: Southwest became the third major US airline this month to cut its 2026 profit outlook because of higher fuel costs.
news.conclusionZh: 燃油成本高企，西南航空下调全年利润预期
news.whyEn: It shows how the oil shock is flowing into corporate earnings and higher airfares for consumers.
news.whyZh: 油价冲击正传导到企业盈利和消费者机票价格
news.detailEn: Southwest now expects adjusted earnings of $2.60 to $2.85 a share in 2026, down from $3.25 to $4.25 in July. Its average fare rose almost 27% year over year to $231.69, while passenger numbers fell 3.2%. CEO Bob Jordan said demand remains strong despite higher fares. The airline has been overhauling its model with bag fees and assigned seating to lift revenue.
news.detailZh: 西南航空现预计2026年调整后每股收益为2.60至2.85美元，低于7月预测的3.25至4.25美元。平均票价同比上涨近27%至231.69美元，乘客人数下降3.2%。CEO乔丹表示，尽管票价上涨，需求依然强劲。公司近年通过收取行李费、指定座位等方式改造商业模式以提升收入。

news.titleEn: Bank of Korea holds rates after President Lee calls for boosting housing supply
news.conclusionEn: The Bank of Korea kept its policy rate at 3% after two straight hikes, as inflation stays above target and chip exports boom.
news.conclusionZh: 韩国央行连加两次后按兵不动，利率维持3%
news.whyEn: It signals Asian central banks are still in tightening mode as inflation persists, despite strong AI-driven export growth.
news.whyZh: 通胀未退，亚洲央行紧缩周期或未结束
news.detailEn: Inflation was 2.9% in September, at or above the 2% target for 13 straight months. ING said the pause is unlikely to end the tightening cycle given resilient growth. September exports surged a record 83.7% year on year, with semiconductor exports up more than 262% on AI demand. The decision followed President Lee Jae Myung's call for an all-out effort to boost housing supply.
news.detailZh: 韩国9月通胀为2.9%，已连续13个月达到或高于2%的目标。ING认为，鉴于经济增长韧性较强，此次暂停不太可能意味着紧缩周期结束。受AI需求推动，9月出口同比创纪录增长83.7%，其中半导体出口增长超过262%。此前总统李在明呼吁「全力」增加住房供应。

businessTips.explanationEn: A single point of failure is any one component, supplier, person or system whose breakdown stops the whole operation. Identifying SPOFs is a core part of risk management and business continuity planning. The fix is usually redundancy, diversification or a tested fallback plan. Ignoring them is cheap until the day something breaks.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单点故障指的是某一个部件、供应商、人员或系统一旦出问题，整个业务就会停摆。找出单点故障是风险管理和业务连续性规划的核心。解决办法通常是冗余备份、分散依赖或准备好经过演练的备用方案。忽视它平时看起来省钱，直到出事那天。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week's PHP flaws forced some organizations to take websites offline because their whole web presence depended on one software stack. A small business can map its SPOFs by asking: if this supplier, platform or employee disappeared tomorrow, what would stop working?
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周PHP漏洞事件中，一些机构的网站全部依赖同一套软件，只能整站下线。小企业可以逐项问自己：如果明天这个供应商、平台或员工突然不在了，哪些业务会停？以此找出自己的单点故障。

businessTips.explanationEn: Cost pass-through means passing rising input costs on to customers, often via a clearly labeled surcharge or an index-linked price clause. It protects margins when costs like fuel, materials or freight jump unexpectedly. Being transparent about the reason reduces customer pushback. Building the clause into contracts upfront is far easier than renegotiating later.
businessTips.explanationZh: 成本转嫁是指把上涨的投入成本转给客户承担，常见做法是单独列出的附加费，或与某个指数挂钩的价格条款。当燃油、原材料或运费意外大涨时，它能保护你的利润率。说明清楚原因能减少客户反感。在合同里提前写好这类条款，比事后重新谈价容易得多。
businessTips.exampleEn: Airlines like Southwest are raising fares as fuel climbs. A side-business delivery or cleaning service could add a small fuel or supplies surcharge that adjusts monthly, rather than absorbing the cost or doing a large across-the-board price hike.
businessTips.exampleZh: 西南航空等公司在油价上涨时提高票价。做配送或清洁副业的人，可以设置每月调整的小额燃油或耗材附加费，而不是自己硬扛成本，或者一次性大幅全面涨价。

businessTips.explanationEn: A sovereign spread is the gap between one government's bond yield and a benchmark considered safer, such as France versus Germany in the euro zone. A widening spread means investors demand extra compensation for that country's fiscal or political risk. It is a quick gauge of market stress that often moves before ratings agencies act. Spreads also affect what companies and households in that country pay to borrow.
businessTips.explanationZh: 主权利差是指一国国债收益率与更安全的基准国债之间的差距，比如欧元区里法国国债对德国国债。利差扩大说明投资者要求更多补偿来承担该国的财政或政治风险。它是衡量市场压力的快速指标，往往比评级机构调整更早反映问题。利差还会影响该国企业和家庭的借贷成本。
businessTips.exampleEn: With France's 10-year yield touching 5%, investors watch the OAT–Bund spread to see whether the stress is French-specific or Europe-wide. If French yields rise while German yields stay put, the spread widens and signals country-specific risk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 法国10年期收益率触及5%时，投资者会看法德利差，判断压力是法国独有还是欧洲普遍。如果法国收益率上升而德国不动，利差扩大，说明是法国自身的风险。
